_comment: The claims the smoke scenarios prove (#1055). One row per scenario under live/smoke/scenarios/ that is a claim;
import, greenfield and full are demos, not claims, and carry no row. live/smoke_claims_test.go holds this file to the
scenario directory and to the site's per-claim pages, and site/data/claims.json is a byte-for-byte copy the site renders.
providers.<name>.status is one of: proven (a scenario runs on that substrate and passes), restated (the claim holds in a
different or weaker form, said in note), n/a (the claim's premise does not exist there), open (not yet stated either way).

themes.adopt: Adopt live infrastructure without state surgery
themes.gate: The platform's own policy engine gates every write
themes.cache: The state file is a cache you are allowed to lose
